title: Refresh the purchase order match warnings of a draft line as soon as it is edited
summary: Purchase order match warnings now refresh immediately when a draft line is edited, eliminating stale warning messages after the user corrects values like unit cost.
key_points: Editing Quantity, Direct Unit Cost, Line Discount, Line Type, No. or Unit of Measure saves the line and recalculates the warnings before the page refreshes
A corrected line shows No warnings right away instead of the old warnings
The Warnings column goes away once no line has a warning
Works like the purchase order subform, which saves the line before recalculating totals
Page-only change: warnings are recalculated once more per edit
